titulo: 1Password said hackers broke into its internal systems, but customer passwords are safe
resumo_original: The password manager maker said an attacker gained access to an employee's corporate account and took some information about customers.

titulo: Want to buy your kid an AI toy this Christmas? Not in New York
resumo_original: New York has banned AI chatbot toys for five years as new research from Common Sense Media reveals troubling safety failures, including exposure to inappropriate content and risks to emotional development.

titulo: DOJ accuses former cyber executive of defrauding ransomware victims by secretly paying hackers
resumo_original: U.S. prosecutors accused the former executive of defrauding victims of ransomware by paying the hackers, charging victims more, and pocketing the difference.

titulo: State AGs fight Character AI’s plan to auction off users’ private chats
resumo_original: The proposed Character.ai bankruptcy sale includes sensitive personal data from more than 21 million U.S. accounts, including 2.1 million registered to minors, the state AGs said.

titulo: X’s latest update for creators focuses on vertical video
resumo_original: As short-form video ramps up in popularity, X's new creation tools are part of its effort to compete with YouTube and Instagram.

titulo: Backblaze explains why it's sharing customer information with advertisers
resumo_original: Backblaze tells Ars it won't share users' backup, storage files with advertisers.

titulo: The FCC has authorized SpaceX to deploy 1 million satellites
resumo_original: This constellation would increase the number of satellites in orbit by roughly 50-fold.

titulo: Ladybird browser's first downloadable alpha is surprisingly capable
resumo_original: An independent browser engine arrives on Linux and macOS, and we've tried it.
